en.headline: Meow-cation exhibition at DX design hub links cats, textiles and Sham Shui Po craft
en.dek: The community-driven showcase features a giant cat installation made from local textiles and runs until 2 November at the Hong Kong Design Centre venue in Sham Shui Po.
body: A community-driven exhibition titled Meow-cation – With Cats, We Connect is on display at the DX design hub in Sham Shui Po, using design and craftsmanship to connect local textile traditions with the neighbourhood.

Organised by the Hong Kong Design Centre, the showcase transforms the beauty of textile manufacturing into a large cat installation. It forms part of the hub’s wider programme exploring design, memory and everyday life in the district.

The exhibition opened on 6 August and continues until 2 November. The DX design hub is located at 280 Tung Chau Street, Sham Shui Po. Opening hours are Monday and Wednesday to Sunday from 11 am to 7 pm; it is closed on Tuesdays. Admission is free.
The Hong Kong Design Centre said the piece aims to bridge communities through design and craft, highlighting Sham Shui Po’s textile heritage and the role of cats in local shop culture.

zh.headline: DX設計館《喵之旅》展出 以紡織與貓咪連結深水埗社區
zh.dek: 社區主導展覽以本地紡織物料製成巨型貓咪裝置，展期至11月2日，於深水埗香港設計中心場地舉行。
body: 深水埗DX設計館正舉行社區主導展覽《喵之旅——與貓連結》，以設計與工藝連結本地紡織傳統與社區。
展覽由香港設計中心主辦，將紡織製造之美轉化為巨型貓咪裝置，屬設計館探索設計、記憶與區內日常生活的系列活動之一。
展覽於8月6日開幕，展期至11月2日。場地設於深水埗通州街280號DX設計館，開放時間為周一、周三至周日上午11時至下午7時，逢周二休館，免費入場。
香港設計中心表示，展覽希望透過設計與工藝連結社區，突顯深水埗的紡織遺產以及貓咪在本地店舖文化中的角色。
